campaign_scheduled_has_date.name: campaign_scheduled_has_date
campaign_scheduled_has_date.value: "campaign"."status" not in ('SCHEDULED', 'SENDING', 'SENT') or "campaign"."scheduled_at" is not null

competition_credit_entry_sign.name: competition_credit_entry_sign
competition_credit_entry_sign.value: ("competition_credit_entry"."kind"::text in ('GRANT', 'PAYOUT', 'REFUND') and "competition_credit_entry"."amount" > 0) or ("competition_credit_entry"."kind"::text = 'STAKE' and "competition_credit_entry"."amount" < 0) or "competition_credit_entry"."kind"::text in ('ADJUSTMENT', 'REVERSAL')

competition_rotation_window.name: competition_rotation_window
competition_rotation_window.value: "competition_rotation"."starts_at" is null or "competition_rotation"."ends_at" is null or "competition_rotation"."ends_at" > "competition_rotation"."starts_at"

document_article_number_check.name: document_article_number_check
document_article_number_check.value: ("document_article"."unit_type" = 'ARTICLE' AND "document_article"."number" IS NOT NULL) OR ("document_article"."unit_type" = 'SECTION' AND "document_article"."number" IS NULL)

interaction_has_subject.name: interaction_has_subject
interaction_has_subject.value: "interaction"."person_id" is not null or "interaction"."organization_id" is not null

recognition_member_of_month_complete.name: recognition_member_of_month_complete
recognition_member_of_month_complete.value: "recognition"."kind" <> 'MEMBER_OF_MONTH' or ("recognition"."committee_id" is not null and "recognition"."month" is not null)

committee_budget_open_approved.name: committee_budget_open_approved
committee_budget_open_approved.value: "committee_budget"."status"::text <> 'OPEN' or ("committee_budget"."student_development_approved_on" is not null and "committee_budget"."vp_finance_approved_on" is not null)

form_window_ordered.name: form_window_ordered
form_window_ordered.value: "form"."closes_at" is null or "form"."opens_at" is null or "form"."closes_at" > "form"."opens_at"

badge_definition_special_target.name: badge_definition_special_target
badge_definition_special_target.value: "badge_definition"."family" <> 'SPECIAL' or ("badge_definition"."special_challenge_id" is not null) <> ("badge_definition"."special_occasion_id" is not null)

booster_item_single_target.name: booster_item_single_target
booster_item_single_target.value: not ("booster_item"."target_challenge_id" is not null and "booster_item"."target_occasion_id" is not null)

point_entry_panal_checkpoint_consistent.name: point_entry_panal_checkpoint_consistent
point_entry_panal_checkpoint_consistent.value: "point_entry"."panal_checkpoint" is null or ("point_entry"."kind"::text = 'PANAL' and "point_entry"."panal_checkpoint" between 1 and 3)

point_entry_panal_reward.name: point_entry_panal_reward
point_entry_panal_reward.value: "point_entry"."kind"::text <> 'PANAL' or ("point_entry"."panal_checkpoint" is null and "point_entry"."points" = 6) or ("point_entry"."panal_checkpoint" is not null and "point_entry"."points" = "point_entry"."panal_checkpoint")

point_entry_reward_range.name: point_entry_reward_range
point_entry_reward_range.value:
("point_entry"."kind"::text <> 'CHALLENGE' or "point_entry"."points" between 1 and 20)
        and ("point_entry"."kind"::text <> 'BOOST' or "point_entry"."points" between 1 and 1000)

appointment_macroevent_consistent.name: appointment_macroevent_consistent
appointment_macroevent_consistent.value: ("appointment"."kind"::text = 'MACROEVENT_DIRECTOR') = ("appointment"."edition_id" is not null and "appointment"."role_code" is not null)

permanence_decision_person_scope.name: permanence_decision_person_scope
permanence_decision_person_scope.value: "permanence_decision"."committee_id" is not null or ("permanence_decision"."decision" in ('CONTINUES', 'EXIT_OE') and "permanence_decision"."proposed" in ('CONTINUES', 'EXIT_OE'))
